# CMP2 group 278 (00103102-00103D92). No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies layout.

column2: That woman ran off without even fighting!
As you'd expect of an $$異端審問官$$!
She's on another level from any ordinary town $$神官$$!
But thanks to this armor $$パルタ$$ left behind...
even a coward like me was able to survive.
But even if we obtain all the strength in the world...
It'll be all right.
Being strong is absolutely right in $$この世$$!!
People at the $$総本山$$ will understand someday!
Come on, everyone...
Don't look so glum.
We still don't know anything about his $$ご主人様$$, but let's cheer up and go investigate soon!
Yeah.
Even with the armor, we're still nowhere near strong enough to stand against the $$教団$$.
$$ガイ$$ is right...
To find what each of us seeks...
and, more importantly, to survive, we cannot stop here.
To borrow $$ガイ$$'s words, we are between a tiger before us and a wolf behind us!
Good grief. Let's hope the old man doesn't overdo it.
Huh?!
I've got to write that in my $$日記$$ too!!
What's wrong? You're not running away?
But I... I can't do anything alone.
Even if I ran... I'd be caught and put up for $$競売$$ as a $$奴隷$$ again!!
That's not true! Make your own future, and do what you want!
But... I can't do it alone...
What do you say? Shall we take her with us?
Take her with us!!
Do not take her with us!
Really? Is that all right?!
All I can do is pick up money, though...
Well... why not? He says it's fine, doesn't he?!
$$アークエン$$ joined the party!
You're right!
I can't keep relying on others forever.
I'll find what I want to do with my own strength!
Movie: "Two Chains Break"
